styleBase: Head-and-face portrait for a 1990s arcade basketball video game, bold comic-book caricature style: thick confident black ink outlines, cel-shaded flat colors with one or two hard-edged shadow tones, slightly exaggerated strong facial structure (defined jawline, cheekbones and brow), an adult pro athlete with a cool, tough attitude. NOT cute, NOT chibi, NOT anime: normal-sized eyes, no blush, no sparkles. Strict front view, perfectly symmetrical, head upright, looking straight at the camera, mouth closed. The scalp is completely bald and smooth with NO hair on top of the head (hair is added later in 3D), but keep the eyebrows and the facial hair exactly as described. No neck, no shoulders, no clothing, no headband, no hat, no jewelry. Only the head, centered, filling about 85 percent of the image height, on a perfectly flat solid pure green background (#00FF00) with no gradient and no cast shadow. No text, no border, no watermark.
